summary: Both editions were independently compared with every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the Spirit/Son identification, the church-and-angel sequence, necessity, repeated strength wording, substantive negations, and all twelve mountain descriptions. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions and compressed descriptions retain the source’s substantive meaning. “Angel of repentance” follows current contextual terminology policy. The notes distinguish working readings, reported alternatives, editorial restorations, and witness gaps without requiring replacement of the selected readings. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and disclosure of the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify editions, or establish exhaustive collation.
